versions.changelog:
- Major skill overhaul: repurposed from "Skinny Fat AI TikTok carousels" to "under-eye dark circles" TikTok slideshow creation.
- New output format: Generates dynamic, 5-slide content flows (was 6 slides, now 5).
- Hooks and storylines are now entirely unique and creative for each draft—no static templates.
- Visuals for slides 1–4 are generated using the "Nano Banana" tool with strict TikTok aesthetic prompts; consistent character per story, randomly chosen from diverse profiles.
- Slide 5 is reserved for a call to action (CTA) and does not include an image.
- Old fitness/body transformation themes and specific brand colors/standards have been fully removed.

- Initial release of the TikTok slideshow creation skill for the Skinny Fat AI app.
- Generates viral TikTok photo carousels with custom hooks, image prompts, and CTA slides.
- Supports specific triggers such as "create TikTok", "make slideshow", and related phrases.
- Enforces strict slideshow format: 6 portrait slides, using realistic images with no faces, and branded colors.
- Provides detailed instructions for hook formulation, image generation, and text overlay specifications.
